ayahs.footnotes: [1985] An oath in which Allāh swears by time throughout the ages.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
ayahs.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
